title: 2024年6月 六级听力真题 (第1套)

sentences.english: Good morning, everyone. Today we'll discuss urban planning and sustainable development.
sentences.chinese: 大家早上好。今天我们将讨论城市规划和可持续发展。

sentences.english: Cities around the world are facing unprecedented challenges from climate change and rapid urbanization.
sentences.chinese: 世界各地的城市正面临来自气候变化和快速城市化前所未有的挑战。

sentences.english: Green roofs and permeable pavements can absorb significant amounts of precipitation.
sentences.chinese: 绿色屋顶和透水路面可以吸收大量的降水。

sentences.english: However, modern urban designers are increasingly advocating for nature-based solutions and green architecture.
sentences.chinese: 然而，现代城市设计师越来越提倡基于自然的解决方案和绿色建筑。

sentences.english: These innovative approaches not only reduce environmental impact but also improve residents' quality of life.
sentences.chinese: 这些创新方法不仅减少环境影响，还提高了居民的生活质量。

questions.question_text: What is the main topic of this conversation?
questions.options: ["A) Climate change","B) Urban planning and sustainability","C) Green architecture","D) Population growth"]
questions.explanation: The speaker introduces urban planning and sustainable development at the beginning.

questions.question_text: According to the speaker, what can green roofs do?
questions.options: ["A) Reduce noise","B) Absorb precipitation","C) Generate electricity","D) Cool buildings"]
questions.explanation: The speaker explicitly mentions that green roofs can absorb significant amounts of precipitation.
